name: article-to-epub
description: Marketplace copy support for Article to EPUB, a local-first extension that creates Kindle-ready EPUBs from article pages.

interface.shortDescription: Draft polished Article to EPUB marketplace copy.
interface.longDescription:
Article to EPUB helps turn article pages into Kindle-ready EPUB files with local preview, editable metadata, image-aware size controls, and manual handoff through Amazon-supported document routes.

This Codex plugin provides a focused skill for drafting and validating marketplace-facing copy for Article to EPUB. It keeps listing language accurate, privacy-aware, and careful about Amazon non-affiliation while helping prepare plugin metadata, Chrome Web Store descriptions, permission justifications, screenshot captions, and release copy.
defaultPrompt: Draft Article to EPUB marketplace descriptions.
Review Article to EPUB permission copy.
Polish Article to EPUB privacy summary.
